executive_summary: The infrastructure shows moderate utilization and no immediate end-of-support (EOS) risks, but has a single server with multiple workloads. There is a risk of hardware failure or software crash due to the high CPU and RAM utilizations.

predicted_failures.description: The server is under moderate utilization, but with high CPU and RAM utilizations. This increases the risk of hardware failure or software crash.

root_causes.description: The infrastructure relies on a single server for multiple critical services, increasing the risk of a failure impacting all workloads.

preventive_measures.action: Implement load balancing and distribute the workloads across multiple servers.
preventive_measures.rationale: This will reduce the risk of a single point of failure and improve overall system reliability.
